en.headline: Police arrest 64-year-old over alleged indecent assault at Wong Tai Sin Hospital
en.dek: A 64-year-old discharged patient was arrested on Friday after a female staff member at Wong Tai Sin Hospital reported being indecently assaulted while on ward duty the previous day.
body: Police arrested a 64-year-old man on Friday in connection with an alleged indecent assault on a female staff member at Tung Wah Group of Hospitals Wong Tai Sin Hospital.

The hospital said a staff member reported that she had been indecently assaulted while on duty in a ward on Thursday. The hospital notified police immediately after receiving the report. Officers later arrested the man, who had already been discharged, in the Wong Tai Sin district on suspicion of indecent assault.

A hospital spokesperson said the institution was highly concerned about the incident and strongly condemned the alleged unlawful conduct. It adopted a zero-tolerance attitude, would follow up seriously and would fully cooperate with the police investigation. The hospital has expressed sympathy and provided support to the staff member concerned, and has reported the case to the Hospital Authority Head Office through the Advance Incident Reporting System.
The man remains in custody for questioning. The case is being handled by the fifth team of the Wong Tai Sin District Criminal Investigation Squad.

zh.headline: 黃大仙醫院職員疑遭非禮 警方拘捕64歲已出院男病人
zh.dek: 東華三院黃大仙醫院一名女職員周四在病房執勤期間懷疑被非禮，警方周五拘捕一名已出院的64歲男病人。
body: 警方周五拘捕一名64歲男子，他涉嫌在東華三院黃大仙醫院非禮一名女職員。
院方表示，一名職員周四在病房執勤期間懷疑被非禮，院方接獲報告後隨即報警。警方其後在黃大仙區拘捕該名已出院的本地男子，涉嫌非禮。
黃大仙醫院發言人表示，院方高度關注事件，強烈譴責涉嫌的違法行為，並採取零容忍態度，嚴肅跟進及全力配合警方調查。院方已向涉事職員致以慰問及提供支援，並已透過早期事故通報系統向醫院管理局總辦事處呈報。
被捕人現正被扣留調查，案件交由黃大仙警區刑事調查隊第五隊跟進。
